senses.gloss: अर्ह mf(आ)n. meriting, deserving (praise or blame, cf. पूजार्ह, निन्दार्ह), worthy of, having a claim or being entitled to (acc. or Inf. or in comp.)
being required, obliged, allowed (with Inf.)
becoming, proper, fit (with gen. or ifc.), Pañcat.
worth (in money), costing, R., (cf. सतार्ह, सहस्रार्ह)
अर्ह m. a N. of Indra, L.
अर्ह f(आ). or (आणि) n. pl. worship, ChUp.
अर्हक mfn. entitled to (comp.), Hcat.
little, small (for अर्भक), L.
अर्हण mfn. having a claim to, being entitled to (in comp.), BhP.
अर्हण n. deserving, meriting, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 111, worship, honour, treating any one (gen.) with respect, Mn. iii, 54; BhP.
a present of honour, MBh. i, 130; BhP.
अर्हणा f. worship, honour, N. Ragh. &c.
अर्˚ह॑णा ind. Ved. instr. according to what is due, RV. i, 127, 6; x, 63, 4 and 92, 7.
अर्हणीय mfn. worthy to be honoured (superl. -तम), MBh.
अर्हणीय—तम mfn. worthy to be honoured (superl. -तम), MBh.
अ॑र्हत् mfn. deserving, entitled to (acc.), RV.
used in a respectful address for अर्हसि, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 133, able, allowed to (acc.), RV.
worthy, venerable, respectable, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. (see अर्हत्-तम below)
praised, celebrated, L.
अ॑र्हत् m. (अन्) a Buddha who is still a candidate for Nirvāṇa
(= क्षपणक) a Jaina
an Arhat or superior divinity with the Jainas
the highest rank in the Buddhist hierarchy, L.
अर्हत्—तम mfn. (superl.) most worthy, most venerable, Mn. iii, 128; BhP.
अर्हत्—त्व n. the dignity of an Arhat, Kathās.
अर्हन्त mfn. worthy, L.
अर्हन्त m. a Buddha, L.
a Buddhist mendicant, L.
a N. of Śiva, L.
अर्हन्तिका f. N. of a Buddhist nun, Daś.
अर्हित mfn. honoured, worshipped, L.
अर्ह्य mfn. worthy (‘of praise’, स्तोतुम्), L.
अर्हरिष्व॑णि mfn. (said of Indra) exultant [formed by irregular redupl. of √ हृष्, BR.; अर्हरि-ष्व॑णि, ‘making enemies cry aloud’, Sāy.] RV. i, 56, 4.
अर्हसान m. the moon, L.
a horse, L.
आर्हत mf(ई)n. (fr. अर्हत्), belonging to an Arhat or Jaina saint, Prab.
आर्हत m. a Jaina, a follower of Jaina doctrines, Prab.; VP.
a Buddhist, AgniP.
आर्हत n. the Jaina doctrine, Jainism.
आर्हन्त्य n. (g. ब्राह्मणादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 124), the state or practice of an Arhat or Jaina saint.
आर्हायण mf(ई)n. (fr. अर्ह, g. अश्वादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 110), a descendant of Arha.
